summary: TLV record parser over a caller-provided byte array. v1 trusts the 16-bit length field and never checks that the header or body fits in the buffer, so accessors read past the end (CWE-125); v2 adds the bounds checks, v3 is a behaviour-preserving refactor of v2, v2c lowers the record-size cap constant.

pairs.intent: CWE-125 fix: tlv_next now rejects a truncated header or a body that runs past the buffer (TLV_ERR_TRUNC) before handing out a value pointer, tlv_peek_type stops reading at the end, the new helper tlv_record_fits centralises the test, and the unchecked tlv_skip_raw is removed.

truth.label: changed
truth.notes: CWE-125: the 3-byte header and the length-sized body were never checked against the remaining bytes, so tlv_be16 and every value accessor could read past the end of the caller buffer; v2 returns TLV_ERR_TRUNC instead.

truth.label: changed
truth.notes: CWE-125: read buf[pos] even when pos == len; v2 returns TLV_ERR_END.

truth.label: added

truth.label: removed
truth.notes: unchecked advance of the cursor removed with the fix

pairs.intent: Behaviour-preserving refactor of v2: operand order, temporaries, loop style, renames, case label order, and the type table moved above the cursor code.
